wider_than_probe.finding: With Alt held (no Ctrl), Up/Down do not touch beta: they add (up - down)/zoomingSensitivity (default 25) to inertialRadiusOffset. Only Left/Right add 1/angularSensitivity to alpha. 'A full step on each axis' reads as alpha and beta.

An arrow pressed while Meta is held is never added to the held set, so after Meta is released it still adds nothing, though the arrow is still held. The arrow's later key-repeat keydowns would add it again.

After camera.limits is assigned a new object, attachGeospatialControls' zoom clamps by the NEW object: with a new radiusMin of 3990, wheel zoom-in stops at radius 3990, against 10 with the original object. applyCollision and planet picking read camera.limits too. So 'changes no clamping' holds only for the camera's own setters and setGeospatialOrientation. (Note number is the position in mended.md of ticket d's note; see unclear item.)

With a parent, getCameraPosition gives the eye in world space: parent translation (100,0,0), alpha 0, beta PI/2, radius 10, target 0 gives x = 110, not target + radius*(...) = 10. The formula holds only in the parent's space.

Ticket g (attachFreeControl drag): with the default inertia of 0.9, one 100 px pointermove turns _yaw by 0.481 in total over the following frames, not 100/angularSensitivity = 0.05. The accumulator decays by inertia each frame, so 'turns by its clientX/clientY change' holds only with inertia 0. _pitch is also clamped to +-(PI/2 - 0.01), and a downward dy lowers _pitch. (The note's position in mended.md was not looked up, so 0 here means unknown.)

mends: a, note 10: attachControl keys need enableArcRotateKeyboardControls(). Per frame held arrows add 1/angularSensitivity to inertialAlpha/BetaOffset, with Ctrl 1/panningSensitivity to inertialPanningX/Y, over hypot; Alt alone: alpha as plain, Up 1/zoomingSensitivity to inertialRadiusOffset, no hypot. Keys down under Meta are void.

b, note 14: resolveCameraViewport counts camera.viewport.y from the bottom but returns y from the top: {x:0,y:0,width:0.5,height:0.5} on 800x600 gives {x:0,y:300,width:400,height:300}. It clamps edges to [0,1] ({x:-0.5,width:1} gives width 400); getEffectiveAspectRatio and _applyCameraViewport clamp nothing.

c, note 37: getProjectionMatrix ignores camera.viewport. getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, w, h) is w/h * viewport.width/viewport.height from the raw fields (w/h with no viewport): the width/height ratio of _applyCameraViewport's rectangle up to pixel rounding, not of resolveCameraViewport's when that clamps an edge.

d, note 38: A GeospatialCamera clamps by the limits object it was made with: a field edit applies at the next yaw/pitch/radius write that changes the value or any center assignment. A new camera.limits object is read by attachGeospatialControls (zoom, planetRadius), not by it. pitchDisabledRadiusScale = null allows full pitch.

e, note 5: An ArcRotateCamera's eye in its parent's space (getCameraPosition gives world space) is target + radius*(cos(alpha)*sin(beta), cos(beta), sin(alpha)*sin(beta)), a sin(beta) of 0 read as 0.0001; alpha and beta are stored as written until setCameraLimits runs. It looks at target there with up (0,1,0).

f, note 39: setGeospatialOrientation always wraps yaw and pitch to [-PI, PI) and re-applies the camera's limits, even given no field; an omitted or null field keeps its current value. The yaw, pitch and radius setters do nothing when the value equals the stored (wrapped, clamped) one; the center setter always re-applies.

g, note 43: attachFreeControl drags from pointerdown (button 0-2, any pointerType) to any pointerup, not pointercancel. A move adds its clientX/Y change/angularSensitivity, not movementX/Y; each frame of its scene adds x to _yaw (left-handed), y to -_pitch, within +-(PI/2-0.01), then scales both by inertia, 0 under speed*0.001.
